name: Kaiserblick
beschreibung: Ferienhaus Kaiserblick is peacefully situated in a sunny location in the traditional spa health resort of Bad Häring in Tyrol's Inn Valley. This charming holiday home offers a welcoming private retreat complete with a private entrance, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable living quarters, and a delightful garden. The balcony commands scenic views of the surrounding alpine summits. Local spa facilities, shops, and restaurants are all within comfortable walking distance. The location serves as an ideal base for restorative spa stays and hiking in summer, alongside easy access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area in winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming holiday residence in the spa town of Bad Häring featuring a garden, mountain views, and tranquility.
